## Finding the original amount {#fm1-reverse .fm-slide }

The final amount includes the percentage change.

$$\text{Final amount}=\text{Original amount}\times\text{multiplier}$$

::: {.takeaway}
$$\text{Original amount}=\frac{\text{Final amount}}{\text{multiplier}}$$
:::

A 10% discount leaves **90% of the original**.

::: notes
Booklet §1.4, p. 4. Use a forward multiplication arrow and reverse division arrow in OneNote. An increase of 10% on the sale price does not undo a 10% discount, because it uses a different base.
:::
